verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs mention "scheduled imports" alongside native connectors and open APIs. That is a first-party recurring-job capability, but only for data ingestion and only as a single passing marketing mention. The Analyst Agent's "continuous monitoring" is an adjacent claim and does not show user-defined scheduling. missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of general workflows or agent tasks beyond imports, documented cron/recurrence controls, scheduling via API or MCP, any KB-level documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
